messages.content: When was the late train scheduled to reach the siding?
At midnight.
What fish did the servants bring to Jim on a silver platter?
Turbot.
What birds did the palace serve Jim on toast?
Roasted quail.
What had the dragonettes' mother gone to hunt?
Their dinner.
What did the Mangaboos sprinkle over the buried Sorcerer?
Water from a brook.
What did the Braided Man invent to make his fortune?
An Adjustable Post-hole.
What did Tik-tok dance on the last evening in Oz?
A jig.
What song did the Tin Woodman sing on the last evening?
A love song.
What did Ozma hold in her hand during the trial?
A jewelled sceptre.
What did Ozma wear on her brow during the trial?
A sparkling coronet.
Why could the Wizard's balloon not rise after he fell?
He had let out too much gas.
